svg.title: Index Translator browser components, requests
svg.desc: The page's main module builds the translation request. The request module builds the body from the form and the glossary module parses the glossary. The model selector picks the model by the text's length. The main module posts the request to the server, reads its event stream, and the state and render modules update the page. Server errors are described by the API module. a request: public/app.ts → Server API. choose the model: public/app.ts → public/request.ts → public/select-model.ts.

g.text: wires the page, sends the request
